name: AdCreative.ai
summary: AI ad-creative and banner generation for performance marketers.
best_for: performance marketers and stores that test many ad variations across sizes and platforms and want on-brand creative volume without a designer bottleneck
skip_if: you run a handful of static ads a month (a designer or Canva covers it), or your bottleneck is offer/targeting rather than creative volume
honest_knock: The meter counts downloads, not campaigns: iterate seriously on ad variations and a 20-credit Starter month evaporates in an afternoon, which is exactly what iteration-heavy ad work does. And the honest fundamental: AI creatives give you volume and speed, but the offer and the hook still decide performance: a mediocre offer with 500 AI banners is 500 mediocre banners. Size the credit tier to your real testing cadence.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month for 20 credits and 1 brand
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-26 on their own homepage pricing table and FAQ) Credit-metered: the FAQ says a credit is used when you download a generated ad creative, that plans include a set number of monthly credits which renew every month, and that generating is unlimited. No free plan; the 7-day trial includes 20 credits. Prices are unchanged, but since October 2026 every step carries more credits. Starter is 1 user: $39 a month for 20 credits and 1 brand, $89 for 50 credits and 2 brands, $139 for 85 and $189 for 120. Professional is 10 users and 10 brands: $249 for 300 credits, $339 for 450 and $400 for 600. Ultimate is 20 users and 25 brands: $999 for 300 credits, $1,099 for 450 and $1,399 for 600. Under a Black Friday banner, quarterly and yearly billing show $20, $125 and $500 a month at the entry steps. The table is not consistent with itself: the Professional card also says 'Brand Limit: 3', and the yearly Ultimate card says 'Brand Limit: 5' and 'Total Users: 25', so confirm brands and seats at checkout. Until at least 2 October 2026 the same prices bought 10, 15, 30 and 50 credits in Starter, 50, 75 and 100 in Professional and 100, 150 and 200 in Ultimate (archived copies of the homepage).
